sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC directory identifies named production, well-record, and related query systems and publishes update-frequency labels.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records the exact official route and system name and repeats the RRC boundary that online datasets are informational, continually updated, non-authoritative, and without legal force.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Production Data (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC production page describes compilations and summaries of production information reported by Texas operators and links the PDQ and Production Reports Query routes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to identify a source class and route; it does not analyze production or draw an ownership, payment, property-connection, forecast, or value conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official PDQ FAQs state the reporting levels for oil and gas, reporting lag, revision and correction behavior, snapshot character, coverage period, query navigation, and monthly update cadence.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article converts those source-stated limits only into locator fields and status labels; it does not classify a result as complete, current, accurate, applicable, connected to private property, or suitable for review.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Well Records (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official well-records page identifies useful request fields, record classes, coverage periods, online and historical channels, and the Commission private-rights authority boundary.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records a locator without interpreting a filing or establishing lease effect, royalty rights, payment entitlement, property connection, operator responsibility, or regulatory compliance.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Data Sets Available for Download (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official download page identifies free dataset names, file formats, and stated update schedules, including a Production Data Query Dump.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only the official dataset label, format, stated update cadence, access date, and result-reference location. It does not download, convert, analyze, select, or recommend a dataset.
